name: docker-volume-runtime
goal: Run offline Linux tasks from Docker-owned workspace and Bun cache storage with bounded tmpfs, preserving task output, workspace edits and cleanup.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Benchmark #173 held-out suite overhead moved from +19.8% with binds to -13.3% with guest storage. Make the actual worker and orchestrator use a task-owned volume, guest Bun cache and bounded tmpfs with no host mount; preserve edit and checkpoint handoff.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The adapter command case previously asserted a host bind. Strengthen that same exact-argv test, plus the existing live process lifecycle case for volume policy, byte transport, workspace reconciliation, abort and cleanup.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness regression d035b75d1b failed the existing argv test on the host bind mount. All test and fixture bytes stay frozen for green.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Stage the disposable worktree through the daemon into a task-owned volume. Keep the original nonroot entrypoint at /workspace with bounded tmpfs. Import edits, deletions and checkpoints on exit before scoped cleanup.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
